classification.diagnostic_retained_view: Both observations pass after changing the emitted payload mux default to the retained per-rule source. Generated header dates differ separately.
classification.generated_live: Both stable and post-admission-changing inputs behave as documented. Generated do snapshot spelling is correctly rejected.
classification.local_trigger_external_entry: Intermediate control gates on external start, not the generated request; payload failure is further isolated by request-specific entry.
classification.local_trigger_request_entry: Confirmed delayed snapshot loss after one accepted request; stable and changed sources both read zero.
classification.local_trigger_without_entry: Authored free-running transaction; not a confirmed entry-injection defect. T1171 and rule docs use the generated request in the target authored on guard.

counterfactual.classification: Single-source emitted-HDL diagnostic control, not production lowering or a multi-source arbitration policy.
counterfactual.comparison_normalization: Remove exactly one generated // Date: header line from each raw retained HDL before comparing the single-assignment edit. No executable HDL is normalized.

limits: Local do capture remains unqualified until caller/callee controllers execute.
Multiple-source selection, busy requests and repeated/nested binding qualification remain implementation requirements.
